title: Laser: L0 and L3 variations
desc: Three new versions of the game's current laser (L0) and three of the pulse lance (L3), J: IMPROVE with no note, "3 new variations each".

takes.name: as before
takes.facts: the game's laser today, two twisting translucent tubes, for comparison

takes.name: twisted ribbon
takes.facts: the two strands as crisp edges of one see-through ribbon twisting to the target

takes.name: ladder helix
takes.facts: two thin rails with rungs; a bright wave runs up the rungs to the target

takes.name: spiral bolts
takes.facts: short spiralling bolts chasing each other down a dark thread

takes.name: bead train
takes.facts: solid glowing beads ride a thin core + L3's two rims + sparks

takes.name: heartbeat
takes.facts: lub-dub double pulses travel the beam; ring and hit flares beat with them

takes.name: bolt volley
takes.facts: separate bolts, 3 blocks a tick, one every 3 ticks, flash and sparks on each hit
